_comment: Accepted worldserver log noise. Every entry is a deliberate decision with a
reason -- either the volume is expected, or it is known debt with a plan.
`python tools/audit_logs.py --check` reports anything above its max, plus any
new signature at or above new_signature_threshold.
The point of this file is the ratchet: when a fix lands, drop the number to 0
so the problem cannot quietly come back. Raising a number is allowed, but only
with a note saying why the new volume is acceptable.
`signatures` is empty until the first run with the file appenders on flags 7
(timestamp|loglevel|logfiltertype). Before that the logs carry no category, so
any signature key baselined from them would be stale the moment the prefix
appears. Populate it with `--baseline`, then replace the placeholder notes.
The named_checks below are prefix-independent and so are valid already.

config-missing-property: Was 23/run: the deployed configs/worldserver.conf was older than the binary
and lacked 23 keys the core asks for. Fixed by regenerating every deployed
config from its .dist template via tools/sync_configs.py, with Alonecraft's
deviations kept in a tracked override layer. Run `python tools/sync_configs.py`
to see drift before it becomes warnings again. Must stay 0.
config-duplicate-key: Was 1: LLMChatter.PrioritySystem.SafetyEnable appeared twice in the deployed
mod_llm_chatter.conf (hand-edited; the .dist has it once). Gone after
regeneration; sync_configs.py --check now fails on any duplicate key.
sql-duplicate-entry: Was 1192/run (1177 character_spell, 15 character_talent), one per bot.
NOT cosmetic: each duplicate rolled back the whole Player::SaveToDB
transaction, silently discarding inventory, quests, skills and achievements.
Fixed by making CHAR_INS_CHAR_SPELL / CHAR_INS_CHAR_TALENT use ON DUPLICATE
KEY UPDATE, plus the missing CHAR_DEL_CHAR_SPELL_BY_SPELL in
Player::removeSpell for PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY entries. Must stay 0.
sql-transaction-aborted: 0 and must stay 0. This is the symptom that matters most -- it means a
character save was thrown away. It was previously invisible because it logs
at WARN and Logger.root was set to 2 (Error); root is now 3 (Warning).
creature-invalid-unit-class: Was 2/run: custom creature_template entries 200008 and 200009 have
unit_class = 0. Fixed by module SQL woa_2026_08_05_00.sql.
playerbot-no-ai: 0 in the sampled run, but the call site is inside the per-update bot loop
with no dedupe, so one desynced bot produces an error every cycle forever.
Budgeted at 0 so the spam loop is caught the first time it fires.
teleport-invalid-map: 1 occurrence (map 530, Z = -200000) -- a failed ground-height lookup,
probably a missing or mismatched vmap tile. Deliberately not investigated:
one instance is not worth chasing. Budgeted at 0 so a recurrence surfaces.
leftover-debug-gossip: Was 9/run and scales with play: LOG_ERROR debug instrumentation in
MiscHandler.cpp firing on every gossip click, by every player and bot.
Committed by mistake in bb88cdaca. Removed. Must stay 0.
leftover-debug-razorscale: Was 24/run: LOG_ERROR debug instrumentation in boss_razorscale.cpp, also
from bb88cdaca. Removed (the behavioural fixes in that commit were kept).
